intro: StorageCafe has no city statistics page for Morgantown. UnitSight's September 2026 street-rate index, from 26 facilities and 425 listings, puts the standard 10x10 at $88. SpareFoot's unspecified 10x10 average was $125.08 on September 1, 2026, included here as $125. The advertised rate averages those two figures. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (UnitSight street rates; SpareFoot 10x10 average). No StorageCafe industry-statistics page; no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page.

units.notes: UnitSight standard street rate $38 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$92. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).
UnitSight standard street rate $88 (Sep 2026), 26 facilities. SpareFoot unspecified average $125.08 on Sep 1, 2026, rounded to $125. Climate-controlled on the UnitSight page ~$124.

local_tips: UnitSight tracks 26 facilities and 425 listings in Morgantown (September 2026). The standard 5x10 ($38) prints below the 5x5 ($40) on that page; both figures are used as published.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
